note: Both sets share significant errors, including misreading 'ring shank nail' as 'ank nail' and misinterpreting a vertical dimension in Detail C1 as 'center-to-center spacing'. Set A is slightly better because it extracts specific bolt attributes (diameter and length) which are critical engineering data, whereas Set B only identifies the bolt type. Set A also has slightly fewer duplicate claims (e.g., Set B duplicates frame and joist dimensions, while Set A captures joist but misses frame, resulting in less overall redundancy).
remarks: Both sets suffer from the same 'ank nail' misread and the same geometric misinterpretation of the 1'-4 3/4" dimension. The extraction tool seems to have a systematic issue with the nail text. Set A's precision on fastener dimensions makes it more useful for engineering review despite missing the explicit 'frame' dimension claim.
